test_name: Verify User Login via GitHub Integration
description: Tests the ability of a user to log in using GitHub authentication and validates successful access to the dashboard.
steps: Verify the visibility of the GitHub login button.
Click on the GitHub login button.
Wait for the GitHub authentication interface to load.
Confirm authentication via the GitHub interface.
Verify redirection to the https://dev.roost.ai dashboard.
Assert the presence of user-specific elements on the dashboard.
expected_results: User is successfully authenticated via GitHub.
User is redirected to the dashboard.
edge_cases: GitHub login button is not visible.
Authentication fails due to incorrect GitHub credentials.
User is not redirected to the dashboard post-authentication.
GitHub authentication interface fails to load.
data_requirements: Access to the GitHub authentication interface.
User account registered with Roost platform.
dependencies: Roost platform backend is functioning correctly.
User has an active GitHub account linked to Roost.
api_interactions: Roost backend API for user session creation.
Dashboard API to fetch user-specific data.
performance_metrics: Time taken for GitHub authentication interface to load.
Loading time for user-specific elements on the dashboard.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the GitHub login button is labeled appropriately for screen readers.
Verify color contrast ratios for the button.
Test keyboard accessibility for the login button.
